messages:
Tara: deploy-bot paused the release for me — flagged a feature-flag default mismatch between staging and prod.

deploy-bot: releasecheck FAILED for release/2026-03-21.
 - check: feature-flag-default-parity
 - key: enable_semantic_rollout
 - staging: true
 - prod: <missing>
 - reason: secret 'app/config/feature-flags' in prod missing sops KMS metadata tag 'kms: redwood-main'

Miguel: huh. we rotated the sops secret last night. could be the rotation job dropped the metadata tag.

Jess: confirmed in audit logs — rotation job 2026-03-20T23:12 created a new ciphertext but the sops header line with "kms_mapping" is absent for prod namespace.

Cory: quick question: is the flag read from a plain secret OR a wrapped config map? If it's plain, we can backfill the default without touching sops.

Jess: backend reads env var via config service which prefers secret value, fallback to default only if absent. So prod not having key -> fallback disabled. Backfilling a secret will set it for prod.

Tara: decision needed: rollback the rotation (undo last-night rotation) vs patch prod with a minimal secret backfill to restore the flag. We have a 1hr change window at 14:00 UTC.

Miguel: rollback rotation is disruptive — it touches all secrets rotated that job. Patch is lower blast radius. I'm +patch.

Cory: agree patch. But we should also pin the service image to avoid any config parser changes from the new build while we're mid-fix.

deploy-bot: suggested temporary action: 
 - pin service backend/web to image tag v2.14.3 (current stable)
 - create secret patch for prod: `kubectl -n prod create secret generic feature-flags --from-literal=enable_semantic_rollout=true --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -`
 - run canary (1 pod) for 5m health checks

Jess: I'll open the patch PR and the pin PR now. Will also include a manual backfill step for the sops metadata so future rotations include kms tag.

Tara: assign owners: @Jess patch secret & PR; @Cory pin image + monitor; @Miguel run sops rotation audit and add postmortem item. Change window 14:00-15:00 UTC. If canary fails, rollback plan = revert to image tag v2.14.2 and re-run rotation rollback.

Jess: PRs posted: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/pulls/4321 (secret backfill) and https://git.redwood/repo/deploy/pulls/4322 (image pin). Deploying canary now. :rocket:

ops-bot: canary deployed (backend/web-679d8) — healthchecks ok after 45s. Metrics: error rate steady, p95 latency +3ms.

Miguel: starting sops audit now, grabbing rotation job log: `kubectl -n infra logs job/sops-rotation-2026-03-20 -c rotate`

Tara: great work. keep this thread for status. I'll draft a short release note about the hotfix and that we manually backfilled the prod secret due to sops metadata omission.

Jess: will add the rollout checklist to the PR, and attach a snippet for the manual backfill command.

Cory: 👍 once patch is verified we'll unpause the release and continue normal rollout.

Tara: marking this thread as the source of truth for coordination. :thumbsup:
